headline: Board approved minutes from March 10 and March 11, 2026 meetings; no appellants appeared for motor vehicle assessment hearings.
summary: The Board of Assessment Appeals met to hear motor vehicle assessment appeals but no appellants appeared. The Board approved minutes from the March 10 and March 11, 2026 meetings and discussed office procedures and upcoming March meetings.
decisions: Approved the minutes for the March 10th and March 11th 2026 meetings unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: Ms. Emilia Menna-Erdmann made a motion to approve the minutes for the March 10th and March 11th 2026 meetings, seconded by Mr. Vitali and passed unanimously.
